title: Alef Manga has contract terminated after latest disciplinary removal at Remo
seoTitle: Alef Manga Has Contract Terminated by Remo
subtitle: The forward reaches his third removal in three seasons and has his deal terminated
excerpt: Alef Manga was dropped by Remo after arguing with captain Marllon following a 2-1 loss to Santos, and the board confirmed the termination of his contract.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On the evening of October 19, Remo lost 2-1 to Santos at the Mangueirão and, at the end of the match, forward Alef Manga got into an argument with defender Marllon, captain of the Pará-based club. The incident culminated in the player's immediate removal from the squad and, two days later, the board formalized the contract termination.

Immediate removal after match against Santos

According to a report by journalist Magno Fernandes, head coach Thiago Carpini requested Alef Manga's removal right after the altercation with Marllon. Right-back Marcelinho confirmed that the argument was part of the squad's internal accountability, but did not detail the duration of the removal.

History of consecutive disciplinary actions

This is his third removal across three different seasons. In 2025, the forward was dropped by Avaí during the Série B campaign, and in 2024 he was sidelined from Coritiba's activities after being implicated in Operação Penalidade Máxima, which investigated match-fixing schemes. In both cases, the club did not disclose details regarding the reasons.

Performance at Remo prior to termination

Upon arriving at Remo in early 2026, Alef Manga was considered one of the main attacking bets. He played 34 official matches, scored six goals, and became the squad's second-highest goalscorer of the season, trailing only Yago Pikachu and Jajá, who have seven goals each. In May, he led the team in goal contributions with four goals and three assists across fifteen rounds, but lost his spot on the bench in recent months.

Impact on Remo's campaign

With the defeat to Santos, the club dropped to 19th place with 23 points and recorded its fifth consecutive winless match. Remo now enters a hiatus for the FIFA international break before facing Grêmio on October 7.

Confirmation of contract termination

Journalist Paulo Fernando Bad Boy, in contact with members of the club's board, confirmed that Alef Manga's contract was terminated this Monday, October 21. To date, there is no information indicating that the altercation with Marllon is directly tied to the decision to terminate the deal.

With information from UmDois Esportes, Esmeraldino.com, O Liberal.
